cost.t: The estimated cost is accredited first because it is the basis for the ±20% check at commercial analysis and for approval authority.

approval.t: Method selection follows Article 11 — and splitting requisitions to dodge Financial Authority is prohibited.

preq.t: Pre-qualification ensures serious bidders — suspended and blacklisted vendors are excluded.

announce.t: Public tender: three newspapers + the LC and ROC websites, for no less than 21 days, with no conditional pre-qualification.

invite.t: Minimum invitees by method: 2 for limited, 3 for direct and RFP.

tech-open.t: Technical envelopes open first, by a committee independent of the commercial analysis committee.

tech-analysis.t: The technical offer is evaluated before any price is seen — late bids are auto-rejected.

comm-open.t: Commercial envelopes open for the technically-qualified only.

comm-analysis.t: Award goes to the lowest qualified bid, provided it does not exceed +20% of the accredited cost.

ratify.t: Above Financial Authority requires company ratification, and the MCT is notified of the final value after award.

sign.t: Refusal to sign forfeits the bid bond and bans up to 12 months, with award passing to the second offer.

wizreq.title: New purchase request
wizreq.doneDesc: Your request now appears to management in the Follow-up Room to accredit the cost and method. You'll get a task in “Required of me today” as soon as it's accredited, to start the first stage.
wizreq.sub0: One decision: what do you need?
wizreq.sub1: One decision: what is it worth, roughly?
wizreq.sub2: One decision: which method to buy through?
wizreq.help0: Describe the need precisely enough to price it — vague descriptions are the top reason requests get returned by management.
wizreq.help1: The estimated value determines the method and approval authority, and is the basis for the later ±20% check.
wizreq.help2: The system suggests the method from the value per Article 11 — departing from it requires a recorded justification.
wizreq.help3: Durations are generated from the articles' minimums, computed in working days (Fri/Sat excluded).
wizreq.help4: After submission the manager accredits the cost and method, then the tender stages are generated automatically.
wizreq.name: Request name
wizreq.namePh: e.g. Water-injection pumps for well B-07
wizreq.descPh: Core specs, quantities, and delivery location…
wizreq.thresholds: SCPP thresholds — set automatically by value
wizreq.split: Splitting the request into smaller ones to lower the threshold is an explicit violation the system flags automatically.
wizreq.orOther: Or pick another method — requires a justification recorded in the request
wizreq.justLabel: Justification for departing from the suggestion — mandatory
wizreq.justPh: e.g. Single accredited source for OEM parts per the manufacturer's letter…
wizreq.cPathMatch: Method selected — matches the system suggestion
wizreq.reviewedLabel: I reviewed the stage plan and its dates
wizreq.finalNote: After submission the request appears to management in the Follow-up Room to accredit the cost and method — you'll get a new task as soon as it's accredited.
wizreq.noFields: No fields for this company — a super admin adds them with their contracts under “Fields”.
wizreq.faUnresolvable: This field has no effective Service Contract — a tender cannot be raised; a super admin fixes it under “Fields”.

wizad.title: Announcement & invitations wizard
wizad.doneDesc: The announcement period runs automatically until {{end}}, and you'll get a task three days before closing to prepare publication proofs. The stage now shows “In progress” on the timeline.
wizad.sub0: One decision: how does it reach the market?
wizad.sub1: One decision: when does it start and how long?
wizad.sub2: Pick the channels that satisfy the article
wizad.help0: Public: 3 newspapers, both websites and 21 days. Limited: a pre-qualified list with a minimum of invitees. Direct: at least 3 invitees.
wizad.help1: The period counts from the first actual publication day — and if the end lands on a holiday, receipt extends to the next working day.
wizad.help2: Every publication channel needs a proof attached at stage completion — name the channels now so the system asks you to prove them later.
wizad.help3: The publish button only enables once conditions are met, and once published the period counter starts and cannot be undone.
wizad.desc_public: 3 newspapers + both websites · ≥ 21 days · no prior list
wizad.desc_limited: Invitations from the pre-qualified list · ≥ 2 invitees
wizad.desc_direct: At least 3 invitees · for justified cases
wizad.holidayNote: If the end lands on an official holiday, receipt extends to the next working day — handled automatically.
wizad.adBody: Al-Waha China Oilfield Co. — Ahdab field announces its need; bids are submitted no later than {{end}} per the approved tender documents.
wizad.publishWarn: Once published, the period counter starts automatically and cannot be undone — any later change requires a documented corrective announcement in the file.
wizad.lcNote: This tender’s scope falls under the state-company participation requirement (§9 / Article 25) and its value is above the financial authority — so it cannot be published until the 20% local-content participation clause is affixed to the tender documents (C8.1). Affixing is a drafting duty that precedes publication, distinct from a company actually participating (C8.2).
wizad.lcClauseLabel: The 20% local-content clause is affixed to the tender documents
wizad.lcClauseOn: Affixed — recorded in the audit log
wizad.lcGate: Publication is held until you attest the 20% clause is affixed to the documents (C8.1).
wizad.cLcClause: The 20% local-content clause is affixed to the documents (C8.1)

wizev.title: Evaluation results wizard
wizev.doneDesc: The recommendation and its minutes are now with management in the Follow-up Room. After ratification the MCT is notified of the final value and the tender moves to contract signing.
wizev.sub0: Classify each bidder before any price is seen
wizev.sub2: Automatic comparison to the accredited cost
wizev.sub3: Send the recommendation with its minutes
wizev.help0: The technical offer is evaluated before any price is seen, and late bids are auto-rejected — that's why prices are locked on this screen.
wizev.help1: Commercial envelopes open for the technically-qualified only, and excluded bidders' prices are never revealed.
wizev.help2: Award goes to the lowest qualified bid provided it does not exceed the accredited cost by more than 20%.
wizev.help3: The recommendation is sent with its minutes to management for ratification — appearing to them immediately in the Follow-up Room.
wizev.cReasons: A reason recorded for each excluded bidder
wizev.gateDesc: The system will open envelopes of the technically-qualified only ({{n}}) — excluded bidders' prices stay permanently locked and shown to no user.
wizev.openBtn: Open commercial envelopes for the qualified
wizev.openedNote: Envelopes opened — the event is recorded in the audit log under the opening committee. Enter the revealed prices for the technically-qualified.
wizev.noPrices: Enter the qualified bidders' prices in the previous step so the verdict computes.
wizev.recDelta: Below the accredited cost by {{pct}}% — meets the article
wizev.minutesLabel: Commercial analysis committee minutes — signed by all three members
wizev.recNote: Once uploaded, the recommendation appears to management in “Follow-up Room — decisions awaiting management”, and the stage only closes with their ratification.
wizev.noBidders: No bidders entered yet — add bidders to begin technical evaluation.
wizev.docsTitle: Stage documents — the condition for closing it

wizev.docsNote: Sending the recommendation closes the commercial-analysis stage, and closing requires its documents.

wizco.title: Stage completion wizard — {{stage}}
wizco.doneDesc: The timeline and status report were updated, and the next stage opened automatically with its planned dates — you'll find it in “Required of me today” when it's due.
wizco.sub0: Record what actually happened — deviation is computed automatically
wizco.sub1: Closing condition: the stage's documents are complete
wizco.sub2: Every delay is documented with a classified reason
wizco.help0: Dates are entered as they actually occurred — the system computes the deviation in working days and shows it in every report.
wizco.help1: A stage doesn't close before its documents are complete — they are the file's evidence at any later audit.
wizco.help2: Positive deviation requires a classified reason that appears in management's compliance report.
wizco.help3: Closing opens the next stage automatically and updates the timeline and status report.
wizco.devAuto: Deviation — computed by the system, not entered manually
wizco.devHintNull: Enter the actual end date and the deviation computes instantly.
wizco.devHintPos: You'll be asked to document the delay reason in step three — and the deviation appears in the compliance report.
wizco.devHintNeg: No positive deviation — step three is passed automatically.
wizco.docsNote: Documents are a closing condition — they stay in the file and appear in the Documents tab and printed reports.
wizco.cNoDev: No positive deviation — no documentation needed
wizco.reasonDetail: Reason detail — appears in the compliance report
wizco.reasonPh: e.g. One accredited newspaper was late to publish on time, so it was re-published…
wizco.noDevBox: No positive deviation on this stage — no reason documentation needed, you can proceed directly.
wizco.finalNote: Closing opens the next stage automatically and updates the timeline and status report — recorded under your name in the audit log.

operators.title: Operators & financial authority
operators.sub: {{n}} operating companies — each company's Financial Authority (§7) governs MCT entry, the ROC participation tier, and split detection
operators.aboveFaNote: Tenders above this company's authority, so they entered the MCT cost cycle (6.9) and ROC witnessing (12.2.2)
operators.name: Company name
operators.faHelp: From the company's own Service Contract (§7) — every operator has its own figure; there is no single global number.
operators.faImpact: Governance impact: this company's above-authority tenders move from {{from}} to {{to}}. That changes the ROC participation tier (12.2) immediately for every existing tender; MCT entry (6.9) applies to new requests only — the case is opened at creation, never retroactively.
operators.faNoChange: No change in the count: {{n}} tenders stay above authority.
operators.faNoChangeNote: This figure has no effect on the MCT cycle.
operators.faReasonPh: Cite the Service Contract amendment or the authorising letter (20+ characters)
operators.dupName: A company with that name is already registered.
operators.faInvalid: Financial authority must be greater than zero — zero would put every request above authority.
operators.empty: No operating companies registered. An operator account cannot be created, nor an authority set, before the company exists.
operators.noDelete: Operators are never deleted: a company is bound to its tenders and its users' accounts, and removing it would sever an existing audit trail.
operators.localNote: Local demo mode — the server has no /api/operators endpoint at all, so this data persists in this browser.
operators.apiNote: The server has no /api/operators endpoint, so the operator registry is not loaded in API mode.
operators.orphanTenders: {{n}} tenders have no owning company — with no field and no service contract their financial authority cannot be derived, so the engine fails closed and treats them as ABOVE authority (§7.1). This only affects data created before tenders carried their operator; there is no retro-assignment action.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.sub: {{n}} holidays — they feed the working-day calendar; every change shifts open deadlines and derived closings (§11.3.4-e)

holidays.addSub: Working-day deadlines and the derived closing of published tenders shift accordingly
holidays.removeHint: Removing a holiday pulls an extended closing back; a bid accepted on the once-extended day can become retroactively late.
holidays.gateDup: This date is already a holiday
holidays.impactNone: No published tender's closing changes with this edit.
holidays.impactSome: The derived closing of {{n}} published tender(s) shifts:
